answer: Suppose a farm wants a hundred names by morning. Ordained beekeeper registration with beekeepers association confirmation says no: a registration the association keeps after apiary audits stands in the way, and the mesa of each fake is a separate errand in the physical world. No reward is issued before the check, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the cipher is that the attacker learns the price before the first coin, not after. Every clone is charged full price a second time, a tenth time, a hundredth time; the island is the reason the farm either stays tiny or collapses.
